The Department of Information Science in the Graduate School of Education at the University at Buffalo, The State University of New York, invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position beginning in August 2027.

We welcome candidates from any area of expertise, with particular interest in applicants working in:

• Sociotechnical policy and ethics
• HCI and human–AI interaction
• Information practices
• Cultural heritage informatics
• Theory development in information science

The successful candidate will maintain an active research agenda, seek external funding, teach four courses per year, advise students across degree levels, and contribute service to the department, school, university, and profession.

For best consideration, please apply by September 15, 2026. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

Full details and application:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States by the start date. The University at Buffalo does not guarantee sponsorship or other assistance with obtaining work authorization.

For questions about the position, please contact:

Amy VanScoy Professor and Search Committee Chair vanscoy@buffalo.edu 716-645-1487
